purpose: The only queries this repo may open a page for. A query with no record here has no evidence anyone searches for it.

provenance.reason: No search-demand source exists for this property. There is no volume, keyword_difficulty, impressions or Search Console data anywhere under data/, and diannesplacerecoveryservices.com does not appear in the portfolio Semrush packet pulled 2026-08-24, so no record could be carried in without inventing one. The 178 items in data/content/content_calendar.json were produced from the dimension arrays in data/authority_scale/authority_config.json.
provenance.how_to_close_it: Verify the property in Google Search Console and export query performance, or run a Semrush keyword pull for the recovery-services terms this site targets, then write the measured rows into records[] with source_type and evidence_tier set.

owner_seed_policy: An owner may add a record with source_type "owner_approved_seed" and volume null. It must carry approved_by and approved_at. Nothing else may create records.
